name: ArchiveBridge
description: Save the current page as MHTML or Safari WebArchive. Firefox support is in progress: this build captures and saves the top document of a page, without its frames.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src blob: data:; connect-src http: https:; object-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
